decks.notes: This deck focuses on using the card Indomitable Creativity to combo with tokens generated from Dwarven Mine, resulting in powerful creature drops such as Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and recursion, while Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending offer removal options. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds a unique and creative element to the strategy. The deck aims to disrupt opponents while building towards a game-winning combo utilizing tokens and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of artifact manipulation and efficient counterspells. It utilizes cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Thopter Foundry to generate value and create a board presence. The inclusion of Portable Hole and Pithing Needle helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce provide additional protection. The deck also features a toolbox of artifacts like Witching Well and Soul-Guide Lantern for added versatility. Overall, the deck aims to outsmart and outlast the opponent through strategic plays and resource management.

The deck's strategy is to cycle through cards, disrupting opponents' strategies with counterspells and hand disruption while setting up for a massive board reset with Living End. By filling the graveyard with cycling creatures and then casting Living End, the player can potentially wipe out their opponent's board while bringing back powerful creatures of their own. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence, utilizing cycling cards and disruptive elements to control the game until the Living End combo can be executed.

This deck utilizes a mixture of different colored lands and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents. By efficiently using mana to cast powerful multicolor spells, the deck aims to control the battlefield and deal damage rapidly. With a focus on resource management and strong creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Territorial Kavu, this deck can apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game. Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding provide disruption while Wrenn and Six help maintain card advantage. Overall, this deck excels at aggressive playstyle and utilizing a diverse range of powerful cards.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play quickly. It also utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also has a land package that includes Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding to support its strategy. The key concept of this deck is to creatively combo off and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while controlling the board with disruptive spells and abilities.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing Cascade mechanics to constantly put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By casting cards with Cascade like Shardless Agent or Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently put powerful threats onto the battlefield while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent early on with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, while also maintaining card advantage and tempo.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful land interactions. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also ramping up mana and setting up for a game-winning Scapeshift or Bring to Light search. With Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove providing additional win conditions, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a decisive victory.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Solitude, and Seasoned Pyromancer while disrupting their game plan with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Blood Moon. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion gives the deck a unique twist, rewarding the player for building a deck with only cards with odd converted mana costs. The deck also has a transformative sideboard plan with cards like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Timeless Dragon to adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures and utilize mana-efficient cards to equip them with powerful equipment such as Cranial Plating and Shadowspear. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, making use of cards like Ornithopter, Frogmite, and Memnite to establish a strong board presence early in the game. The inclusion of artifacts like Urza's Saga and Springleaf Drum also helps ramp up the deck's aggression and synergize with the artifact-heavy strategy.

The deck revolves around using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide control and recursion, while Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer protection and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the various colors needed for the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to surprise and overwhelm the opponent with unexpected creature plays and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also includes a mix of burn spells and counterspells to control the board and protect the combo. The deck aims to surprise opponents and create big swings in momentum with its unique playstyle. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Dwarven Mine adds additional synergy and versatility to the deck, allowing for different lines of play depending on the situation.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With the help of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring, the deck is able to consistently access extra mana for its spells. Cards like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt provide direct damage, while creatures like Tarmogoyf and Wild Nacatl put pressure on the opponent. Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial help control the board, allowing the deck to dictate the pace of the game and secure a swift victory.

This deck is focused on aggressive play using a combination of red and blue cards. It emphasizes quick spells and creature removal to overwhelm the opponent. Key cards include Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Mishra's Bauble for early damage. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation with Expressive Iteration and Consider. It uses counterspells and creature control with Spell Snare, Spell Pierce, and Unholy Heat to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck has a balance of land cards and efficient creatures, making it a strong aggro choice in Modern 1v1 format.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on constant pressure and disruption through efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by removal and counterspells to control the game. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider, while leveraging Mishra's Bauble for additional value. The goal is to quickly establish a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game using powerful artifacts and counterspells while ramping up mana with the UrzaTron lands. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering spells, bouncing problematic permanents, and eventually locking them out of the game with cards like Mindslaver and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. It also has the ability to tutor for key pieces with cards like Trinket Mage and Treasure Mage, while also having a win condition in creatures like Wurmcoil Engine and Walking Ballista.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on deploying threats quickly, controlling the board with counterspells and removal, and utilizing card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent. The key concept revolves around efficiency, versatility, and adaptability to different matchups through a combination of strong creatures like Ragavan and Murktide Regent, disruption with Counterspell and Unholy Heat, and card selection with Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. By combining speed with disruption, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory through consistent aggression and control of the game.
